title: SAWA (Sub-Saharan Africa Watch for Antiretroviral resistance): an open real-time surveillance platform
description: SAWA is an open, reproducible pipeline for continuous antiretroviral-resistance surveillance from public sequence data (LANL, GenBank) with optional integration of partner clinical data. It produces subtype-stratified phylogenies, Stanford HIVdb resistance calls, and transmission-cluster estimates for sub-Saharan Africa, starting with HIV-1 in East Africa. The Python package is named 'hivdrwatch'; the project's short public name is SAWA.
